solution:
The alphabetical series is given as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f12f9c1411f87b98447b11ff5e8b39ad208075edc4a787b34d7062ddff9322b.png] 

ZR 18 is related to UW 11,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ba86622ce065a6ba2c2feb9f4e0c7d0e326caaed83816a72b9538e7da749a49.png] 

YM 24 is related to TR 17,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2129cc18d400de603bac40dff7626cabd7e426ef88dc03947db09fa43a25171.png] 

Similarly, KJ 35 related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca6bd65e1bc5e39c04207698d3540237bb6e0e6018d05eddddcf72fbef46129c.png] 

So, KJ 35 is related to FO 28.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
